title: kbgit.py sync reads the remote ref after a push that timed out before it reports the push failed
goal: When git push does not finish within KB_GIT_NETWORK_TIMEOUT, kbgit.py sync fetches origin and reports pushed: yes when the remote ref holds the local commits, so the SP-foopqq2x claim push that landed is not reported as failed with exit 1
notes: SP-foopqq2x retrospective finding (2026-10-13), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator.
